quarterly_data.quarter: Shibaura Mechatronics press release: Launch of the HSM-1000, Activation & Wet Cleaning System (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Shibaura Mechatronics launched the HSM-1000, an activation & wet cleaning system that performs on a single system the pre-bond surface treatment processes (plasma activation, cleaning and rinsing) required for hybrid bonding and fusion bonding in advanced packaging, for logic and memory applications used in servers and generative AI as well as image sensors. Throughput is 10 or more sets of top and bottom wafers per hour (WPH, under company-specified conditions); combined with the company's hybrid bonders it offers a one-stop solution from pre-bond surface treatment to bonding. The company says hybrid bonding adoption is expanding in advanced packages for logic and memory devices used in high-performance servers, generative AI and high-performance PCs, and in image sensors, and it aims to further expand its advanced-packaging business with this solution.
quarterly_data.figure: WPH of 10 or more sets of top and bottom wafers (company-specified conditions)
